mapper.select: SELECT coalesce((SELECT logo IS NOT NULL FROM company_profile), false) AS branding, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reward_rules WHERE active) AS reward_rule, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS branch, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND business_hours IS NOT NULL AND business_hours <> '{}'::jsonb) AS branch_hours, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM staff_users u JOIN staff_roles r ON r.staff_user_id = u.id WHERE u.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INVITED') AND r.role <> 'COMPANY_OWNER') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM staff_invitations i WHERE i.role <> 'COMPANY_OWNER' AND i.accepted_at IS NULL AND i.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.expires_at > #{now})) AS team, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tags t JOIN branches b ON b.id = t.branch_id WHERE t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.status = 'ACTIVE') AS nfc_tag, coalesce((SELECT enabled FROM feedback_settings WHERE id = 1), false) AS feedback, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND google_review_url IS NOT NULL) AS google_review, coalesce((SELECT enabled FROM referral_settings WHERE id = 1), false) AS referrals, (coalesce((SELECT enabled FROM tier_settings WHERE id = 1), false) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loyalty_tiers)) AS tiers, coalesce((SELECT near_reward_enabled OR winback_enabled OR unused_gift_enabled FROM reminder_settings WHERE id = 1), false) AS reminders, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bonus_rules WHERE active AND (ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= #{today})) AS bonus_rules, (coalesce((SELECT enabled FROM catalog_settings WHERE id = 1), false) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_items)) AS catalog
SELECT recommendations_hidden_at, branding_done_at FROM setup_state WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE setup_state SET branding_done_at = #{now} WHERE id = 1 AND branding_done_at IS NULL
UPDATE setup_state SET recommendations_hidden_at = #{hiddenAt}, updated_by = #{staffId} WHERE id = 1
